connector: Five books, side by side. Today you step back and ask what you discovered. Your theme isn’t just about Narnia or Denmark or Avonlea. It’s about people. Say what it means, in one sentence you’d be proud to sign.

a.raw: peter said he says were getting too old
a.why: Peter’s real words to Lucy (Prince Caspian, Ch. 15): we’re is we are, so it needs an apostrophe.

b.raw: my favorite book this year was number the stars because annemarie was so brave
b.fixed: My favorite book this year was Number the Stars, because Annemarie was so brave.
b.why: Capitals on My, on each main word of the title and on Annemarie; a period ends it. (A comma before because is optional here.)

notes.wgrd: Compare themes across texts: name a theme, find it in two books, and say how the characters show it alike and differently.
vocab: The big idea about life that a story keeps showing.
To tell how two things are alike.
To tell how two things are different.
Details from the text that prove what you say.
notes.wordParts: Every base from the year: port, tract, struct, spect, ject, script, rupt, duct, form, press, tain, lev, plus prefixes like pre-, re-, trans-, inter-.
notes.grammar: Spiral review: capitals, commas, quotation marks, complete sentences. Read your sentence out loud and check each mark has a job.
notes.spelling: Spiral review: drop the silent e, change y to i, double the last consonant when the beat is on the last syllable, and spell each word part the same way every time.

transcripts.welcome: Hoo! It’s Opti. Five books, side by side. Today’s question: what did you discover about people from all of them together?
transcripts.read: Step back from the whole week. Your theme is about more than one story. It’s about real people too. Write what you discovered in one strong sentence you would be proud to sign.
transcripts.grammar: Your best sentence deserves a careful check. Capital at the start. Names capitalized. Commas where they join or separate. Quotation marks around exact words. An end mark that fits. Then read it out loud one last time.
